_comment: Pocket Hatchery — Creature Variation Data v2.0.0 | 2026-07-17 (revised)
_integration: variationSpec.ts → setVariationSpec(). Renderer NEVER reads this file. It is design reference data and the canonical source for variationSpecImpl.ts.
_v1_removed: cssVarsExtended, visibilityMap, chainRarityParam — those targeted the wrong API (SVG mark-N groups + geneDecoder cssVars injection). The real integration point is setVariationSpec().

markingMap._comment: gene.patternType (0–15) → MarkingKind. Renderer draws all markings programmatically via markingFill(). No SVG <g id='mark-N'> groups are needed.

rendererMarkings.description: Diagonal tiled stripe pattern; angle randomised per assetId seed
9 scattered ellipses; position + size randomised per seed
Radial gradient ellipse on ventral area; position jittered ±3px
6 large blurred blobs — appaloosa / cloud look
Linear gradient sweep top → bottom across full body
22 micro-dots; all positions randomised per seed

patternTypeToMarking.note: same kind; creature differs because rnd seed differs
Mythic slot — crown-shards accessory is the statement

accessoryMap._comment: on-chain rarity (0–5) → AccessoryKind. Accessory color is derived from palette.accentHue by the renderer — not set here. 6 tiers (egg_type 0=Common … 5=Mythic). Matches variationSpecImpl.ts ACCESSORY_MAP.

accessoryDescriptions.sparkles: 4 tiny pulsing dots near the sprite
accessoryDescriptions.orbit-motes: 6 larger motes slowly rotating around the sprite
accessoryDescriptions.halo: Elliptical halo above head + orbit-motes — Epic tier
accessoryDescriptions.crown-shards: 5 crystal shards radiating from crown + orbit-motes — Legendary (warm gold rim) and Mythic (ice-blue rim) are distinguished by rim light

eyeHuesTable._comment: gene.eyeColor (0–15 index) → HSL hue 0–360 for CreaturePalette.eyeHue. This is NOT a CSS var — it is a field in CreaturePalette returned by paletteFor().

palettes._comment: Named palettes for NFT metadata + lore UI hover tooltips. NOT read by the renderer. Used for naming creatures and palette-matched metadata generation.

variants.name: Ember
variants.mood: Classic fire sprite — warmth and energy

variants.name: Sunrise
variants.mood: Bright + cheerful — sunbeam in creature form

pluginSummary._comment: Flamingo's complete implementation checklist. Three files total — one new, two edits.

steps.what: Copy the full implementation from spec §3. ~55 lines. Contains MARKING_MAP, ACCESSORY_MAP, EYE_HUES, hslToHex(), and initVariationSpec().
Add two lines before first render: import { initVariationSpec } from './variationSpecImpl'; initVariationSpec();
Add per-tier .artAura overrides from spec §9 to scale aura intensity Common → Legendary.

noChangesTo: web/src/geneDecoder.ts — gene decoding complete; no CSS var additions needed for variation
web/src/creatureRender.ts — compositor already wired to getVariationSpec()
web/src/variationSpec.ts — interface stable; setVariationSpec is the only door
web/public/assets/creatures/foxling.svg — no mark-N groups, no new CSS classes needed
All other species SVGs — variation is species-agnostic via gradient role classification
